description: This file defines the ModelScreen class, which models a screen in the OFBiz widget framework. It includes methods for rendering screens, managing transactions, and accessing screen components.

classes.name: ModelScreen
classes.description: Represents a screen model in the OFBiz widget framework, capable of rendering, transaction management, and component access.

methods.name: getTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Returns the original transaction timeout string.

methods.name: getModelScreenMap
methods.description: Returns the map of model screens.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns the top-level section of the screen.

methods.name: getSourceLocation
methods.description: Returns the source location of the screen definition.

methods.name: renderScreenString
methods.description: Renders the screen to a string, managing transactions and handling exceptions.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves the LocalDispatcher from the context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator from the context.

methods.name: resolveTransactionTimeout
methods.description: Determines the transaction timeout value based on parameters, attributes, or defaults.
